title: Fix Guarded Start Evidence Ordering
summary: Recorded and fixed the guarded-start dirty-tree blocker discovered during the FP-MCP-230 one-shot start attempt. The previous rejected start evidence was first preserved in ForgePilot. The MCP bridge guarded start path was then patched so it no longer writes local start-state evidence into the target ForgePilot workspace before contacting the runner. The bridge now defers local non-start/rejection evidence until after runner validation and skips local post-state writes when execution actually starts, preserving a clean target workspace at runner validation time.
caveats: The running MCP service must be restarted before this bridge fix is active.
This packet did not retry the canary after the fix.
Existing approval/local clearance from FP-MCP-230 are expired and must not be reused.
The fix preserves target workspace cleanliness for runner validation but runner-side behavior still determines whether execution starts.
No approval was consumed by this packet.
